headline: STALLED: the queue is the blocker, and it's proven
lede: Session 52 walked the full claim ladder live for the third time and found the same honest nothing: no halt, steer, next or queued issue, no pushed-branch corpse, both QA streams busy, flagshipStage() null. Three dry sessions in a row is the rule-4 trip, so the builder stopped and reported on #1240, now titled STALLED. Everything between the forge and a game is one label on #1144 (FLOOR BOSS) or #1127 (Wizardry crawler).

notes.text: Rule 4 tripped: sessions 50, 51 and 52 shipped no game code (last merge: ROBOT LAB stage 3, #1237). #1240 is marked STALLED with the full ladder evidence; it asks Jon to label a queue item by Oct 31 — its default is hold-idle, which never self-resolves.
